Once per game, during your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate (even if landed).” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The first image printed the title with a uniqueness dot (“•”); the re-made image drops the dot, so the card is no longer unique as printed (the PC card data always had it without the dot). It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
